description: Consult Babelii's product adviser: it interprets the customer's need (for example "paket data XL murah untuk 3 hari") and returns current catalogue recommendations with price, volume, validity, availability and a buy_url. Prices come only from this result. It never orders; the customer completes the purchase through buy_url. Limited per caller; use once per question, and a clarification in the result means ask the customer. An outside agent calling this tool is not Abel.
name: find_products
title: Rekomendasi produk dari Abel
